outcome: fear for the mother's and the child's well-being
manifestations of childbirth fears (everyday life, stress symptoms, wish to have a Caesarean section)
cohort: 659 first-time mothers were recruited before week 14 of gestation during their first ultrasound screening at a hospital's maternity outpatient clinic.
finding: Mothers in the intervention group, who received enhanced childbirth education, experienced less childbirth-related fear and less influence of fear on their everyday life compared to those in the control group.
